module.name: Repeat Caller
module.description: Repeat Caller detects repeated inbound call journeys, creates actionable incidents, and supports GUI, email, and Alert Call notifications for FreePBX/PBXact 16 and 17.
module.changelog: *1.1.0* First signed FreePBX UK release. Adds per-rule Test Email, improves DID route selection and email sender handling, and introduces 25-record pagination with persistent sorting for incident and alert history tables. *1.0.2* Improves multilingual Alert Call handling, adds native French support with English fallback, and introduces language status and sample playback. *1.0.1* Improves Alert Reminder sequencing, rule editing, DID controls, suppression, snooze, and global controls.
